ChatMessages.Content: Heads-up: Lidia (Contoso's CIO) called me this morning to escalate latency in the EU region. Their Frankfurt workloads are seeing API calls take 4 to 6 seconds during business hours, and their morning export batch is failing with gateway timeouts. It's been going on for about a week.
She was blunt: if this isn't owned and fixed before the renewal, she'll back Daniel on looking at Fabrikam. Fabrikam went back to them last week with 20% off and free migration.
Six weeks to renewal. Megan, who's on this?
Not sure yet. I'll check what Support has open, get owners on it and pull the renewal plan together.

Good. Don't chase Fabrikam's number. Remember Adatum: we matched a discount in the last week with P1s sitting unassigned and lost them anyway. Hold the cap you agreed with Daniel; anything below it needs my approval.
I'll ask Contoso's ops team to file the export timeouts as their own ticket so Support can triage both.
